title: Custom Football Close Up on American Flag Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate sports-themed sanctuary with the custom football comforter set by Jeminise. Featuring a vintage-inspired graphic illustration design of an American football close up on the American flag with stars and stripes, this bedding offers a super soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this custom bedding set brings the spirit of the game directly to your bedroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own text inputs such as name or number for a truly unique sports bedding piece.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Vibrant & Durable: Features an advanced environmental protection dyeing technique that ensures colors hold and prevent fading over time.
  • Available Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a thicker, cozy comforter for all-season warmth.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry on low heat, or air dry to keep the fabric fluffy and soft.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Retro Football Art
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
